name: tisty-share-web
description: The page that reads a Tisty Share link in the browser: it opens the envelope with the key in the link's #, which never reaches the server, and draws the body with tisty-editor.

scripts.wasm: cargo build -p tisty-share-wasm --profile share-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir wasm ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/share-wasm/tisty_share_wasm.wasm && cargo build -p tisty-share-wasm --profile share-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features draw && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir wasm --out-name tisty_share_draw ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/share-wasm/tisty_share_wasm.wasm
